item.title: INstalling and Configuring Apache Server
item.description:
Objective

To install a web server on Linux and access it from the host machine.

Practice Process

I installed Apache2 using sudo apt install apache2. Then I checked the service status using systemctl status apache2. I used curl localhost in the terminal and accessed the Apache dafault page via the virtual machine’s IP address on my host browser.

This experiment gave me a claer understanding of how websites are hosted and served.
